JVNDB-2026-000138
baserCMS plugin "BcAddonMigrator" vulnerable to inclusion of functionality from untrusted control sphere
Overview
baserCMS plugin "BcAddonMigrator" provided by baserCMS Users Community contains the following vulnerability.
Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere (CWE-829) - CVE-2026-97150
Kuniyoshi Noguchi (KuniNogu) of Mitsui Bussan Secure Directions, Inc. reported this vulnerability to IPA.
JPCERT/CC coordinated with the developer under Information Security Early Warning Partnership.

Affected Products
baserCMS Users Community
BcAddonMigrator 5.2.0 and earlier
Impact
Arbitrary files on the system may be read or deleted by an attacker who can log in to the product with an administrative privilege.
Solution
[Update the plugin]
Update the plugin to the latest version according to the information provided by the developer.
The developer has released the following version that addresses this vulnerability.
BcAddonMigrator 5.2.1
